issues.title: 1000 Paintings Challenge — Issue 1
issues.body:
Logan Sevin here. This is the first studio letter from the 1000 Paintings Challenge.

I paint, I ship stills, I run a live gallery at https://1000-l7in.netlify.app/ — original work, authored and owned by me. Not an AI as the artist.

What you can buy this week:
• Original paintings from the challenge — $89
• Generated studio stills — $45
• Custom still (your brief) — $75 via Cash App $Logan7in
• Character sheet — $120
• Brand pack (3 stills) — $250

Tip or commission: https://cash.app/$Logan7in
X: @L7IN597

If you hire artists: I take commercial stills, characters, and brand packs. Reply to this letter with the brief. I invoice on Cash App before files go out.

— Logan Sevin
